schemeScope: Combined Paper 1 and Paper 2 scheme. PDF 17 reading marking instructions; 18–22 Léamhthuiscint A; 22–26 Léamhthuiscint B; 27 literature notes, Gaeilge 5 note and the prose Eolas/Gaeilge table; 28–31 prose; 32–39 poetry; 40 Ceist 4 instructions and its Eolas/Gaeilge table; 41–49 additional literature; 50 modified marking (SMM). PDF 1–16 belong to Paper 1; 51–52 blank.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover, 2 and 14–16 blank or acknowledgements, 3 instructions) and every applicable scheme page read in the text layer and checked against the printed page; each prompt and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder.

nonPoolDecisions: Reading (2021 adjusted paper: Léamhthuiscint A or B): all twelve questions of both passages are carded; each printed part is a practice card at its published tariff. “1 mharc + 1 mharc” answers expose one-mark slots (A2(b)(ii), A5(b)(ii), B2(b)(i), B3(b)(i), B4(b)(ii), B5(b)(ii)); “2 mharc + 1 mharc” items (A2(a), A3(a), A5(a), B1(a), B2(a) and both 6(a)) stay whole as 0/2/3.

A 6(b) has two independent six-mark traits (trait 2 + support 4) with practice slots; B 6(b) is a response (2) and two supported points (5 + 5) inside one response (no slots, as in 2023 B 6(b)). Both must be in the candidate’s own words.
Single-answer parts allow only the mark values the scheme prints for them (0, the printed partials and the full tariff).
Prose, poetry and Q4 choices are closed printed routes (4 + 4 + 6) and were already carded (IDs retained); the optional folktale, short story or poem itself is open content chosen inside one route.
sourceFindings: Paper 2 = 120 (2021 adjusted paper): Ceist 1 one reading passage, A or B, 50 (Q1–5 at 7 = (a) 3 + (b)(i) 2 + (b)(ii) 2; Q6 at 15 = (a) 3 + (b) 12); Ceist 2 Prós 30 or Ceist 3 Filíocht 30; Ceist 4 Litríocht Bhreise 40.
Reading A “John Hume – Laoch na Síochána” (paper 4–5, scheme PDF 18–22); B “Scéalta ón mbliain 2020” (paper 6–7, scheme PDF 22–26).

Literature language: 5 marks for Gaeilge in every literature answer (scheme PDF 27); prose 25 Eolas (2B(a) two traits 13 + 12, 2B(b) theme 2 + development 23); poetry printed (i) 15, (ii) 6, (iii) 9 on the paper, assessed as Eolas 13, 5, 7 plus Gaeilge 5 once; Q4 Eolas 35 (4A with one person only: 35 − 10); 4F printed (i) 20, (ii) 10, (iii) 10, assessed as Eolas 19, 7, 9 (5 + 4) plus Gaeilge 5.

Text layer: the prose and Q4 band tables print the Eolas and Gaeilge columns side by side (scheme PDF 27 and 40); each literature answer closes with the examiner’s marking-panel note, after which the Marc as 4/3/7/5 tables of the sub-questions above are stored (PDF 35, 39, 48). The builder returns each table to the sub-question it prices and ends each answer at that note.
Paper vs scheme wording: A6(b) the paper says “Bíodh sampla amháin ón sliocht agat”, the scheme omits “ón sliocht”. Cards keep the paper’s wording.

Legacy corrections (IDs, totals and topics unchanged): each whole reading question had one undivided criterion; each poem one Eolas criterion of 25. All now carry the lifted 2021 scheme text with per-part and per-sub-question tariffs.
